notes.title: Patch notes 11/5/19
notes.content:
Hey all! We've just gone live with a new update for [i]Corpse Party 2: Dead Patient[/i]. Here's what we've fixed:
[list][*] Arahabaki Escapee achievement no longer triggers accidentally in EX chapter
[*] Players can now confirm by pressing the space key or enter key when the game is launched for the first time and asks about the language and input type
[*] Fixed a typo in the credits for EX chapter
[/list]
